answer: Each identity must employ one distinct part-time aide on real payroll: 6 hours weekly at $18/hour, wages and withholding remitted via a licensed provider that hashes the aide's tax ID into the registry under a sable marker. Providers reject any tax ID tied to another identity; verifiers check weekly pay stubs and quarterly filings, and missed payroll revokes standing. 1,000 Sybils need 1,000 distinct aides and $108,000 weekly in wages plus taxes, with no reuse. Trade-off: a canyon of cost excludes poor honest agents, and a comet-fast surge fails because tax records take weeks.
